nodes.label: GOV-RES-001 governance residual packet (custody, not clearance)
nodes.description: The one bounded Lane A packet that receives non-SM05 governance and documentation residuals from handoffs screened under B-150 (D-364 item 8, created at its first receipt by D-374). Each row records custody (source child, scope, hold, return, completion criterion); a receipt never closes the source's SV-002 section 2.3.1 tracker row, which needs an independent Verified-By or a Judge acceptance with its reason (D-364 item 4). First receipts: B-104.O2 to O4.
